description: NaZnSO₄F crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six O and one F atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.82 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.18 Å. Zn is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form ZnO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ZnO₄F₂ octahedra and corners with four equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. There are two shorter (2.16 Å) and two longer (2.21 Å) Zn-O bond lengths. Both Zn-F bond lengths are 1.96 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent ZnO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-51°. There are two shorter (1.49 Å) and two longer (1.50 Å) S-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Zn, and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one S atom. F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Zn atoms.
